findings.evidence: Inside Filtration.lean the definitional bridge already typechecks in term mode: `filtrationPrevious_zero := TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltrationPrevious_zero (ι Q)` (line 134), `filtrationPrevious_succ := TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltrationPrevious_succ (ι Q) k` (line 139, unfolding both defs), `mul_mem_filtration := TauCeti.Algebra.mul_mem_wordFiltration (ι Q) hx hy` (line 240). This is compatible with the contributor's reply on the earlier reuse thread: the definitions are indeed opaque *downstream* (`public section` without `@[expose]`, Filtration.lean:96), which is why the specializations belong in the defining module rather than as `simp`/`change` unfolding in AssociatedGraded.lean.
findings.fix: Add to TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/Filtration.lean, next to `mul_mem_filtration` (line 238): `theorem mul_mem_filtrationPrevious_left {i j : ℕ} {x y : CliffordAlgebra Q} (hx : x ∈ filtrationPrevious Q i) (hy : y ∈ filtration Q j) : x * y ∈ filtrationPrevious Q (i + j) := TauCeti.Algebra.mul_mem_wordFiltrationPrevious_left (ι Q) hx hy` and the `_right` mirror, exactly as this PR does in UniversalEnveloping/Filtration.lean:157-167. Then delete both private transport lemmas and use `exact mul_mem_filtrationPrevious_left Q hprevious y.property` / `exact mul_mem_filtrationPrevious_right Q x.property hprevious`.
findings.issue: `filtration_eq_wordFiltration` and `filtrationPrevious_eq_wordFiltrationPrevious` (lines 71-81) restate the definitions `filtration Q k := TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration (ι Q) k` (Filtration.lean:116-117) and `filtrationPrevious Q := TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltrationPrevious (ι Q)` (Filtration.lean:129-130), and are then unfolded by hand at both use sites (lines 113-117, 131-135). This is private scaffolding parallel to the specialization API that Filtration.lean already provides, so the next consumer of `filtrationPrevious` multiplication has to re-derive it.

summary: Removing the duplicated Clifford multiplication proofs in favour of the generic word-filtration lemmas is right, but the replacement bridging is done with two private transport lemmas in the consumer module instead of the one-line specializations that TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/Filtration.lean already uses everywhere (and that this same PR adds for the PBW filtration). Everything else in the PR is new material with no Mathlib or TauCeti counterpart.
